_comment: skill name -> exact training prompt. The orchestrator can only pick a name from here. 'scene', 'pickup' and 'looks_like' are plain-language hints for the vision checks; 'concierge', 'offer' and 'good_for' shape the concierge's system prompt. Edit them to match your setup.

concierge.handout: the hand-out tray (the white foam box on the right of the counter)

scene.bin: the designated bin: the white foam box on the right side of the table in the front_wide view
scene.camera: front_wide shows the whole table, with the robot at the top and the bin on the right

bottle.prompt: pick up the bottle and put it in the designated bin
bottle.good_for: thirst, after the sauna or the thermal baths, a guest who feels hot or asks for a drink or water
bottle.pickup: bottles start on the table in the pick-up area (left and middle of the table), not in the bin
bottle.looks_like: a green glass sparkling-water bottle with a white label, standing or lying

towel.prompt: pick up the towel and put it in the designated bin
towel.good_for: the sauna, the thermal pools, a shower, drying off, a guest who is wet or cold
towel.pickup: the towel starts on the table in the pick-up area (left and middle of the table), not in the bin
towel.looks_like: a white cloth towel, usually rolled up; rolled up it can look like a white bottle, but it is soft cloth, not a bottle
